No sommaire in the extract; themes and chapters from the theme introduction pages ('Ce thème comporte les chapitres suivants', p4, p95, p134) and chapter headings. Theme 1 title is not printed as a heading: 'La reproduction humaine' taken from its introduction text. Sections from numbered (1., 2., ...) headings of activities and 'Bilan des connaissances' pages; ch1-2 of theme 1 follow the bilan numbering. Theme 3 intro also lists 'Chapitre 6 : l'hygiène du système nerveux' but the book (265 p.) ends with ch5, so it was omitted. OCR-garbled remerciements ignored.
